# Columbia Libraries Journal Platform

> A comprehensive open-access academic publishing platform hosting peer-reviewed journals across law, sciences, humanities, and social work disciplines through Columbia University Libraries.

Columbia Libraries Journal Platform provides institutional support for scholarly publishing through the OJS platform, hosting journals edited by Columbia University faculty, students, and affiliated academic communities. The platform emphasizes open-access scholarship and provides publishing resources for journal partners.

## Key Topics

- Open-access publishing
- Peer-reviewed journals
- OJS platform
- Academic publishing
- Legal scholarship

## Columbia Law Journals

- [Columbia Business Law Review](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/cblr): Triannual law journal focusing on legal and business community interactions
- [Columbia Journal of Environmental Law](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/cjel): Peer-reviewed law journal covering environmental policy and coastal protection issues
- [Columbia Journal of Gender and Law](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/cjgl): Interdisciplinary law journal promoting feminist inquiry and gender law scholarship
- [The Columbia Journal of Law & the Arts](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/lawandarts): Quarterly student-edited journal covering arts, entertainment, and IP law issues
- [Columbia Journal of Race and Law](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/cjrl): Peer-reviewed law journal examining racial and ethnic justice scholarship
- [Columbia Journal of Tax Law](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/taxlaw): Peer-reviewed forum for tax law and policy scholarship bridging theory and practice

## Undergraduate & Graduate Research Journals

- [Columbia Undergraduate Science Journal](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/cusj): Peer-reviewed undergraduate research journal publishing scientific articles
- [Consilience](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/consilience): Undergraduate research journal focused on environmental sustainability and climate justice
- [Graduate Student Journal of Psychology](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/gsjp): Open-access peer-reviewed journal publishing psychology graduate and undergraduate research

## Interdisciplinary & Specialized Journals

- [Al-ʿUsur al-Wusta](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/alusur): Peer-reviewed journal of medieval Islamic studies published by Middle East Medievalists
- [Current Musicology](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/currentmusicology): Peer-reviewed musicology journal publishing music research and experimental music studies
- [Electronic Journal of Africana Bibliography](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/ejab): Open-access peer-reviewed journal of annotated Africana and African diaspora bibliography
- [Black Theology Papers Project](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/btpp): Annual peer-reviewed journal publishing Black Theology Unit papers from AAR

## Education & Social Science Journals

- [Current Issues in Comparative Education](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/cice): Open-access journal from Teachers College covering comparative international education
- [Columbia Social Work Review](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/cswr): Annual peer-reviewed journal for social work research and scholarship
- [The Journal of Clinical Education in Physical Therapy](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/jcept): Open-access peer-reviewed journal on physical therapy clinical education and simulation

## Publishing Partner Resources

- [Columbia Libraries Journal Partner Resources](https://journals.library.columbia.edu/index.php/cul/resources): Resources and guides for Columbia Libraries journal publishing partners using OJS platform
